query:
SELECT mt.tableName, mf.fieldName, mf.fieldType, mf.businessMeaning
FROM metadata_tables mt
JOIN metadata_fields mf ON mt.id = mf.tableId
WHERE mt.tableName = 'CustTable'
ORDER BY mf.fieldName
LIMIT 30;
